fact: Deputy Health Minister Dkt. Florence Samizi said on 30 September 2026 that electronic patient records have reached 100 per cent in national, specialised, zonal and regional hospitals, nearly 99 per cent in district hospitals and over 67 per cent in dispensaries, and that GoTHOMIS connects 7,700 facilities including over 6,400 dispensaries.
title: Tanzania yajipanga kufadhili na kupanua afya kidijitali
